respaldo: Drawn line from ON-PREM to APP DISCOVERY SERVICE; 'Application discovery service is installed the on-premises server. This really gives us the inbound and outbound TCP connections.'
Drawn line from ON-PREM to EC2 HOT REPLICA; 'CloudEndure live migration agent... it's block by block replication from the on-premises server to AWS.'
Drawn arrow from CLOUDENURE to EC2 HOT REPLICA.
Drawn arrow from MIGRATION TEAM to SLACK; 'It's kicked off from Slack. So the migration team will issue one command.'
Drawn arrow branching from SLACK downward path to DYNAMODB; 'migration team filling DynamoDB with actually metadata.'
Drawn arrow branching to EC2; 'That then effectively talks to the EC2 instance... calls the API on the EC2 instance.'
Drawn arrow from EC2 to APP DISCOVERY SERVICE; 'EC2 instance will talk to the application discovery service to gather the TCB inbound and outbound connections.'
Drawn arrow from EC2 to CLOUDENURE; 'It will also talk to CloudEndure... CloudEndure will then effectively stop the replication.'
Drawn arrow from EC2 to BAKE AMI; 'EC2 instance, or the migration factory, will then bake the AMI.'
Drawn arrow from EC2 crossing dotted line to SHARED AMI; 'share that AMI across to the target account... using the metadata that lives in DynamoDB.'
Drawn arrow from EC2 crossing dotted line to target EC2; 'We then start that instance. And at that point, you're applying all of your sizing and your firewall rules.'
